title: Signal: Certificate authority file configured but empty
scope: A .npmrc file that declares an empty `cafile` setting, which leaves the client with no trust anchor from that path.
limitations: It matches an empty `cafile` setting, which leaves the client with no trust anchor from that path in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions an empty `cafile` setting, which leaves the client with no trust anchor from that path in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
